column2: or a proof that a cell-local cycle triangulation plus shared face segments cannot produce a non-manifold VERTEX. The search space is much smaller than it looks. In this crate every Marching Cubes vertex sits on a grid EDGE
column3: so every face incident to an edge vertex comes from one of the FOUR cells sharing that grid edge. Those four cells span a 3 x 3 x 2 block of grid corners -- 18 corners
